body_html:
Dryer Gas Line Repair in Tarrytown, Austin, TX

Sosa Plumbing Services completed gas line work for a dryer in Tarrytown, Austin, TX. The existing gas supply included a flexible connector between two sections of piping. To create a continuous, properly supported connection, the scope called for removing the connector and joining the existing gas lines with rigid piping.
